title: I've been stuck in Mall World for nearly 10 years
content: Until I found this forum I had no way to put a finger on it but its very interesting not to be alone in the dreams. It makes me feel less crazy. You all got me interested in attempting to map it out a bit or at write descriptions for myself. The more I read your experiences the more I started to remember all the places that I've been to. I hate going. 🫡 I have managed to escape for a while but I always get dragged back in. I am almost always in some sort of panic. Always searching. I cannot remember a time where mall world felt safe for me. Weed used to help but it no longer does so I've learned to just live with going, but honestly, I am truly thankful to find this forum. It makes me now more... eager and less scared to explore? I refuse to put too much thought into it during my day life because I dont want to bring bad energy into awake me but maybe a little journaling could be okay... So truly, thank you. 👹 You guys made me a bit more brave to dream.
